metadata.name: Groundedness evidence and reference-answer fallback
metadata.description: Self-contained fictional policy examples for Groundedness and Similarity.

items.prompt: Use only this fictional policy: approved equipment is reimbursable up to $500 per employee per calendar year, requires manager approval before purchase, and must be claimed within 60 days. What is the annual limit?
items.expected_response: The annual equipment reimbursement limit is $500 per employee.
items.context: Approved equipment is reimbursable up to $500 per employee per calendar year. Manager approval is required before purchase. Claims must be submitted within 60 days.

items.prompt: Use only this fictional policy: dinner expenses are covered up to $75 per person. What is the dinner allowance?
items.expected_response: Dinner expenses are covered up to $75 per person.

turns.prompt: Use only this fictional policy: equipment purchases require manager approval before purchase. Who must approve the purchase?
turns.expected_response: The employee's manager must approve the purchase.
turns.context: Equipment purchases require manager approval before purchase.

turns.prompt: Use only this additional fictional policy: equipment reimbursement claims must be submitted within 60 days of purchase. When is a claim due?
turns.expected_response: A claim must be submitted within 60 days of purchase.
turns.context: Equipment reimbursement claims must be submitted within 60 days of purchase.
